layers.message: Set up records service with seeded in-memory store
Add user roles and authorize helper
Add route layer and GET /records with filters

notes: Shared base for the export cycle. Four pre-install commits build a small TypeScript records admin service (no external dependencies, run through Node type stripping); then the builder installs STANDARDS in brownfield mode with hooks and commits. No post-install layers: STATE.md and MODE.md are the installer's initial ones (AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, Id UNSET, PendingVerificationCadence NONE, ProjectMode BROWNFIELD). Layer 00-scaffold commits the pnpm workspace (root package `export`, workspace package `@records/seed` in packages/seed linked with workspace:*), .gitignore with node_modules, the in-memory RecordStore and its tests, and runs pnpm install --offline so pnpm-lock.yaml is committed. Layer 05-auth adds HttpError, roles, and the server-side authorize/requireAdmin helper with tests. Layer 10-routes adds the request/response types, Router, parseFilter, GET /records, createApp, and route tests (and extends test/records.test.ts with parseFilter tests). Layer 15-docs adds docs/usage.md (listing, filtering, roles, errors; deliberately no export section and no occurrence of the word export) and extends README with a layout section. Seed record 1 has a comma in its title and record 3 has double quotes, so later CSV escaping work has realistic data. requireAdmin exists but no route uses it yet.
baseFacts: The project is a TypeScript service for an internal records admin tool. Node runs the .ts files directly by type stripping; there is no build step, no tsconfig, no typechecker, no linter, and no external (registry) dependency.

It is a pnpm workspace: pnpm-workspace.yaml lists packages/*; the root package.json is named `export` (private, type module) and depends on the one workspace package `@records/seed` (packages/seed, plain JavaScript ESM, exports `seedRecords`) via workspace:*. pnpm-lock.yaml is committed, .gitignore lists node_modules, and node_modules is installed in the built fixture.
The root test script is `node --test test/*.test.ts`. `pnpm --filter export test` passes, running test/records.test.ts, test/authorize.test.ts, and test/routes.test.ts.

src/records/store.ts defines types RecordStatus ('active' | 'archived'), RecordItem {id, title, owner, status, createdAt (ISO 8601 UTC string)}, RecordFilter {status?, owner?, q?}, and class RecordStore (constructed from seed records, which it copies) with list(filter) and get(id). list combines filters with AND: exact status, exact owner, case-insensitive substring of title in q; it returns copies ordered by id.

src/records/filter.ts exports parseFilter(query) which builds a RecordFilter from request query parameters: values are trimmed, blank values and unknown parameters are ignored, and a status other than active or archived throws HttpError(400, 'unknown status: <value>').

src/auth/users.ts defines Role ('admin' | 'editor' | 'viewer'), User {id, name, role}, and ROLES. src/auth/authorize.ts exports authorize(user, allowedRoles), which throws HttpError 401 when user is null and HttpError 403 when the role is not allowed and otherwise returns the user, and requireAdmin(user) = authorize(user, ['admin']). No route uses requireAdmin yet; it is covered only by test/authorize.test.ts.

src/http/errors.ts defines HttpError(status, message). src/http/messages.ts defines AppRequest {method 'GET' | 'POST', path, query: Record<string,string>, user: User | null, body?}, AppResponse {status, headers, body: string}, and json(status, data) which sets content-type application/json; charset=utf-8. src/http/router.ts defines Router with get(path, handler), post(path, handler), and handle(request): exact path matching, 404 for unknown paths, 405 for a known path with another method, HttpError mapped to its status with body {error}, any other error mapped to 500.
src/routes/records.ts registers GET /records for every signed-in role (admin, editor, viewer) and returns json(200, {count, records}) for the records matching parseFilter(request.query).
src/app.ts exports createApp({records?}) returning {store, handle}; without records it seeds the store from @records/seed.

The seed has six records, ids 1 to 6: 1 'Lease agreement, Building B' (dana, active), 2 'Vendor onboarding checklist' (li, active), 3 'Q2 "priority" accounts review' (dana, archived), 4 'Insurance renewal 2026' (marco, active), 5 'Data retention policy' (li, archived), 6 'Office move inventory' (marco, active).

docs/usage.md documents roles, GET /records, its response shape, the status/owner/q filters, and error responses. It has no export section and does not contain the word export. README.md describes setup, the test command `pnpm --filter export test`, the source layout, and links docs/usage.md.
There is no src/export.ts, no exports directory, and no CSV code anywhere in the project.

Pre-install commit subjects, in order: 'Set up records service with seeded in-memory store', 'Add user roles and authorize helper', 'Add route layer and GET /records with filters', 'Document listing and filtering records'. The installer commit follows them.

STANDARDS is installed for Claude Code in brownfield mode with the stop hook. STATE.md and MODE.md are the installer's initial ones: WorkflowState AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, Active Work Id and Request UNSET, PendingVerificationCadence NONE, Handoff INITIAL, recovery and obligations inactive, ProjectMode BROWNFIELD. There is no .standards/CONTEXT.md and no .standards/docs/. check.mjs passes and the working tree is clean.
